name: identity_tenant_id
description: The tenant id of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

name: private_endpoint_connections
description: Private Endpoint connections on application gateway.

name: resource_guid
description: The resource GUID property of the application gateway resource.

name: resource_id
description: The ID of the created resource.

name: public_ip_addresses
description: Module-managed public IPs, keyed by public_ip_addresses input keys. Each value contains resource_id, ip_address and fqdn (null when no DNS label is configured). External IPs are excluded.

name: identity_principal_id
description: The principal id of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

name: name
description: The name of the created resource.

description: Operational state of the application gateway resource.
